purpose: Teach: 小冊子/鉄骨/凝縮/収める/経済学部/新株/チャーター/リクルート

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯小冊子を配付しております
lines.style: Official but not rigid. Even pace, measured delivery. The calm of someone accustomed to public-facing explanations. Professional courtesy without stiffness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、鉄骨倉庫の事故を捜査されているそうですね
lines.en: Yes. I understand the police are investigating the steel warehouse accident.
lines.style: Attentive, acknowledging. Slight uptick after the pause — showing he's been listening and is engaged. Respectful but not deferential. Natural rhythm of conversation with authority.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料を凝縮した報告書を作成しました
lines.en: We've prepared a condensed report compiling our investigation materials.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Even tone, slightly formal. The clarity of someone presenting documented findings. No inflection seeking approval, just laying out facts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、犯罪を確実に収める対策、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the police's thorough measures to prevent crime.
lines.style: Sincere but measured. Respectful pause after the dash. Acknowledging without flattering. The tone of someone speaking to authority with genuine appreciation, not performance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、経済学部出身の捜査官も増えております
lines.en: We're also bringing in more investigators with economics backgrounds.
lines.style: Informative, slightly forward-leaning. The pride of institutional development without self-consciousness. Steady pace, gentle emphasis on 'also' to show evolution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新株発行詐欺の事件、警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: Yes. The police are currently investigating that new share-issue fraud case.
lines.style: Attentive, nodding quality to the voice. Shows he's tracking the broader work. Conversational but respectful. Small emphasis on 'currently' — confirming his understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、チャーター便での要人警護も担当します
lines.en: We handle VIP protection details on charter flights as well.
lines.style: Straightforward expansion of scope. Steady, confident. Not boastful — just adding another line to the portfolio. The ease of someone comfortable with their institution's range.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、リクルート活動も積極的になさっておられますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are really ramping up recruitment efforts, I've noticed.
lines.style: Observant, warmer than previous lines. Slight smile in the voice. Showing he sees the growth trajectory. More personal — moving toward relationship-building after the procedural exchange.
